update orders
status = #{status}, pay_status = #{payStatus}, pay_method = #{payMethod}, checkout_time = #{checkoutTime}, cancel_time = #{cancelTime}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason}, delivery_time = #{deliveryTime}, delivery_status = #{deliveryStatus}, estimated_delivery_time = #{estimatedDeliveryTime}, remark = #{remark}, id = id
where id = #{id} and #{id} is not null
mapper.select: select date(order_time) as date, count(*) as totalOrders, sum(case when status = #{completedStatus} then 1 else 0 end) as validOrders from orders where order_time >= #{beginTime} and order_time < #{endTimeExclusive} group by date(order_time) order by date(order_time)

select od.name, sum(od.number) as number from order_detail od inner join orders o on od.order_id = o.id where o.order_time >= #{beginTime} and o.order_time < #{endTimeExclusive} and o.status = #{completedStatus} group by od.name order by number desc, od.name asc limit 10
